purpose: Fixed illustrative cases for the four-page CVIS draft, separate from historical benchmark estimates
method: eqdisc.discover with default version 1.2 and no truth-based starts
forecast_initialization: fixed-coefficient states-only fit using last 40 training observations; no forecast observations or clean states
attractor: 8000 samples after a further 1000-sample burn, integrate each learned equation autonomously from estimated training endpoint; truth integrated separately from same point
selection: One fixed seed and one run per named system; retain failures; no outcome-based replacement
metrics: exact support, relative coefficient error, coordinate-std-normalized RMSE over first 100 and all 400 forecast samples
interpretation: Qualitative illustrations and deterministic prediction diagnostics, not a new comparative forecasting benchmark
